description_en: Modifies the name of a specified cloud desktop
description_zh: 将指定云电脑的名称修改为新名称
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-desktop-name --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --new-desktop-name DemoComputer01 --desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --desktop-ids example-string --user-assign-mode example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDesktopName

parameters.description_en: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to obtain a list of regions that are supported by Elastic Desktop Service.
parameters.description_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to obtain a list of regions that are supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
The new name of the cloud desktop. The name must meet the following requirements:

- The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

- The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

- The name can contain digits, letters, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).
parameters.description_zh:
修改后的云电脑名称。格式要求如下：

- 不超过64个字符。
- 必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
- 可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、点号（.）或者短划线（-）。
